user_goal: Make the v0.1.9 release authority consumable by the fail-closed single-contract verifier without changing the reviewed product patch.

baseline.selection_reason: The exact reviewed v0.1.9 cumulative diff must be represented by the one contract selected by the verifier and trusted guard.

semantic_changes: Preserve the reviewed v0.1.9 portability, ignore, documentation, version, rollback, checkpoint, and test corrections exactly.
Expose the complete cumulative authorized path set through one append-only successor contract selected by the release pointer.
Do not alter product behavior beyond the already reviewed v0.1.9 patch.

No ledger mutation, unrelated feature or behavior change, foreign listener takeover, secret exposure, tag rewrite, or force push except the documented exact-lease rollback with audit retention, public verification, and live attestation.

invariants: Both predecessor contracts remain byte-identical and validator-valid.
The cumulative baseline-to-candidate diff is exactly the reviewed v0.1.9 release-hygiene patch plus append-only authority artifacts.
Windows continues to run real listener ownership tests while non-Windows skips only Windows process-boundary tests and still runs portable schema coverage.
The machine-local owner record remains present but ignored.
PR, CodeRabbit, CI, signed receipts, public main, tag, installed package, and live service bind one exact candidate.
No merge or release occurs before a fresh independent review, server verifier, and trusted guard PASS against this selected contract.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: The selected contract, predecessor lineage, exact cumulative diff, and full tests validate.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Unallowed cumulative paths, predecessor mutation, or broad platform skip.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: PR 3 has resolved CodeRabbit findings and green exact-head CI.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Merge with unresolved review or failed checks.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Signed receipts, server verifier, and trusted guard approve exact v0.1.9.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Mismatched candidate, contract, diff, or authority.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Public and installed v0.1.9 are exact, healthy, and clean.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Failed Actions, dirty install, or mismatched live service.

proof_requirements.claim: The selected successor truthfully covers the complete authorized diff and all narrow fixes pass locally and cross-platform.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: contract and predecessor validation, cumulative diff audit, full tests, static checks, ignore proof

proof_requirements.claim: All PR review evidence and exact-head CI are green.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: raw reviews, threads, comments, and checks
proof_requirements.expected_observation: zero unresolved findings and all checks success

proof_requirements.claim: Independent review, signed chain, server verifier, and trusted guard approve the candidate against this selected contract.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: production review, canonical receipt validation, release verifier, trusted guard

proof_requirements.claim: Public and installed evidence are exact and clean.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Actions, tag, release, package, owner, connector, health, source parity, git status

release_requirements.required_receipt: signed chain accepted by verifier and guard

stop_conditions: Predecessor drift, unexpected diff, dirty or multiple worktrees, unresolved review, failed CI, non-PASS receipt, verifier or guard rejection, SHA mismatch, foreign listener risk, or rollback failure.
known_discrepancies: The prior selected remediation contract described only review corrections and could not independently authorize the full cumulative diff under the verifier's single-contract model; this append-only successor corrects that enforcement mismatch without changing the product patch.

requirement_trace.authority: User continuation of the reviewed v0.1.9 release through clean public attestation
